description: This file contains unit tests for the installation manager component of the starboard loader application, specifically testing installation roll-forward, revert, reset, and path functions using Google Test framework.

classes.name: InstallationManagerTest
classes.description: A Google Test fixture class for testing the installation manager, with setup and teardown methods, and helper functions for testing installation roll-forward, revert, and path functions.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, creates storage path, and sets up installation store path.

methods.name: SaveStorageState
methods.description: Serializes and saves the installation store state to a file.

methods.name: ReadStorageState
methods.description: Reads and parses the installation store state from a file.

methods.name: RollForwardHelper
methods.description: Helper to test rolling forward to a specific installation index and verify priorities.

methods.name: RevertHelper
methods.description: Helper to test reverting to a successful installation and verify priorities.

methods.name: FileExists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists at the given path.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up test environment, deletes created files and directories.
